Subject: SLA & vendor onboarding details required for procurement setup - Cygnus Cloud

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Procurement is kicking off vendor setup on our side and I wanted to consolidate a short checklist so we can get you into our PO system and complete onboarding before the demo next month. Can you confirm the following items and send any supporting docs?

1) Primary support contacts (phone, email, escalation tiers)
2) SLA targets (monthly uptime, response/priority SLAs for P1/P2/P3)
3) Maintenance windows / scheduled downtime expectations
4) Invoicing remit & PO information (bill-to address, tax ID, preferred PO terms)
5) Any required vendor forms or security questionnaires (we have a standard vendor setup form if you prefer)

If you can reply with the names/emails and an initial PDF of the support/escalation matrix we can attach it to the vendor record. I copied Monica from Procurement and Laura from Sales Ops so we can align on PO timing and SOW items.

Thanks — a short reply with the items above will be perfect.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

2) SLA targets: 99.95% monthly uptime for standard PROD; 99.99% for dedicated instances (commercial agreement). Response targets: P1: 15 min initial response, P2: 1 hour, P3: 4 hours. Full details in attached matrix.

3) Maintenance windows: weekly rolling maintenance window Sundays 0200–0400 PT; emergency maintenance will be notified 48+ hours in advance where possible.

4) Invoicing / PO: Cygnus Cloud, Inc.
  Bill-to: 2380 Harbor Ave, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94124
  Tax ID: 23-4567890
  Net 30 by default; we accept PO references and prefer electronic invoices to ap@cygnuscloud.com

I've attached: Cygnus_Support_Escalation_Matrix.pdf

Let me know if you need the matrix in a different format or a short call to walk through the escalation playbook.

Sam —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. A couple of quick clarifications from Procurement so we can complete the vendor-record: 

• For the "99.95% monthly uptime" line item — do you have a definition document that clarifies measurement windows (UTC vs PT) and credit policy for incidents?
• For P1 response SLA — is the 15 minute "initial response" measured by acknowledgement ticket or by engineered remediation start?
• Can you confirm whether invoices need to reference a Purchase Order number from Redwood? (Yes/no)

I'll start the vendor setup but want to attach an explicit SLI/SLO excerpt so finance knows how to code any credits. If you prefer, share a one-page SLO excerpt and we can push it into the PO terms.

-Monica

Redwood Inference

Monica —

Good questions — answers inline below.

• Uptime measurement & credits: We measure monthly availability in UTC using a 30-day rolling window. Credits: if availability < SLA threshold we apply a service credit calculated as percentage of monthly bill (detailed table in the SLO excerpt attached).
• P1 initial response: the 15-minute clock is for first human acknowledgement and ticket creation; remediation timelines depend on incident type. We can add an engineered remediation start metric if you need that separately.
• PO reference: yes, invoices should reference the Redwood PO number when available. We can accept invoices without PO but credits/payment may be delayed.

I'll attach a one-page SLO excerpt and the updated matrix. If you want an explicit clause for "engineered remediation start" we can add an appendix to the SOW.

Best,
Sam
Attachment: Cygnus_SLO_Excerpt.pdf
